decisions.reason: Define-XML ADAE.TRTEMFL assigns 'N' to every event that is not treatment emergent, while adae.r lines 125-133 run admiral derive_var_trtemfl only on events with ASTDT and set no 'N' value, so other events stay blank in the final ADAE. The program reading TRTEMFL__PROGRAM_BLANK reproduces the reference, confirming the program leaves those events blank.

The literal probe (adae-documented-rules.yaml TRTEMFL) states Define-XML ADAE.TRTEMFL as written, 'Y' when ASTDT >= TRTSDT with both present and 'N' otherwise, and the 65 differences are reference blanks where it gives 'N'. The reading from adae.r lines 125-133, which assign only 'Y', reproduces the reference and is offered as how the reference was computed, not as documentation.

Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM tests AEBODSYS='SKIN AND SUBC UTANEOUS TISSUE DISORDERS', an exact comparison with an embedded blank, while adae.r lines 202-210 detect the substring 'SKIN AND SUBCUTANEOUS TISSUE DISORDERS', and that mutate is the final CQ01NAM value. The program clause therefore differs from the document in both spelling and match type.

Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM excludes AEDECOD in ('COLD SWEAT', 'HYPERHIDROSIS', 'ALOPECIA'), exact membership, while adae.r line 207 excludes any AEDECOD containing one of those strings via str_detect. This is a different computation of the exclusion clause, not a paraphrase, though no record evidence shows it changing a value.

The literal probe keeps Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM as written, substring test on the four strings OR the SOC 'SKIN AND SUBC UTANEOUS TISSUE DISORDERS' with exact exclusions, so the 181 differences are reference query members its misspelled SOC misses. The SOC_SPELLING reading, removing only that blank, reproduces the reference and matches the SOC spelling adae.r lines 202-210 used.

Within Define-XML ADAE.AOCC01FL, CQ01NAM='' selects records outside the populated dermatologic query, while the same method's parenthetical says to flag the first treatment-emergent dermatological event. Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM assigns 'DERMATOLOGIC EVENTS' to query members and missing otherwise, so these clauses describe different subsets.

Define-XML ADAE.AOCC01FL selects empty CQ01NAM, whereas ADRG pages 11-12 explicitly flag the first chronological treatment-emergent dermatological event. Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM identifies dermatological query members by the populated 'DERMATOLOGIC EVENTS' value, making the subsets contradictory.

Define-XML ADAE.AOCC01FL subsets to CQ01NAM='' and TRTEMFL='Y', while adae.r lines 213-221, the last step that sets AOCC01FL, filter TRTEMFL == 'Y' & CQ01NAM == 'DERMATOLOGIC EVENTS'. The program computes the query subset differently from the documented clause.

The literal probe applies Define-XML ADAE.AOCC01FL as printed, CQ01NAM='' with TRTEMFL='Y', USUBJID grouping and ASTDT then AESEQ order, from the published upstream values, giving the 327 differences. The DERM_EVENTS reading, justified by the method's own parenthetical and ADRG pages 11-12 and matching adae.r lines 213-221, reproduces the reference.

Define-XML ADAE.TRTEMFL assigns 'N' otherwise, while the TRTEMFL derivation at adae_v2.yaml line 582 assigns a blank, as its comment at line 576 states. The method description at lines 591-592 repeats the 'N' text, but no derivation branch implements it.

Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM flags any AEDECOD containing 'APPLICATION', 'DERMATITIS', 'ERYTHEMA' or 'BLISTER', while CQ01NAM at adae_v1.yaml lines 544-558 tests exact membership in a fixed preferred-term list. A containing term absent from that list is flagged by the document but not by the specification.

The composed CQ01NAM derivation at adae_v1.yaml lines 539-561 never reads AEBODSYS; only the submission method text at adae_v2.yaml lines 603-607 repeats the Define-XML SOC condition. The fixed preferred-term list stands in for that condition without stating it.

No derivation in the composed specification excludes 'COLD SWEAT', 'HYPERHIDROSIS' or 'ALOPECIA'; CQ01NAM at adae_v1.yaml lines 544-558 only omits them from its fixed list. The exclusion appears only in the submission method description at adae_v2.yaml lines 605-607.

Define-XML ADAE.AOCC01FL and workbook Methods row 45 subset to CQ01NAM='' and TRTEMFL='Y', while DERM_RN at adae_v2.yaml line 806 filters CQ01NAM='DERMATOLOGIC EVENTS'. The entry adae.yaml lines 9-21 repeats the Define text only as submission metadata, so the query-name predicates select different records.

ADAE contains one record per reported event per subject. Subjects who did not report any
Adverse Events are not represented in this dataset. The data reference for ADAE is the SDTM
AE (Adverse Events) domain and there is a 1-1 correspondence between records in the source
and this analysis dataset.
missed.reason: ADRG page-11 states the ADAE record scope, one record per reported AE with a 1-1 correspondence to SDTM AE, and no claim cites it. It governs the all-aes row rule (adae_v1.yaml lines 585-588, dataset AE), outside the variable-derivation claims.
